svg.title: Spain invoice preparation and outbound exchange
svg.desc: Four horizontal responsibility lanes. ERP submits complete draft data for service validation, issues and submits final data. The service resolves the recipient route, uses the public platform when no private entry point exists, and tracks recipient delivery and any required public copy independently.
svg.text: Spain invoice preparation and outbound exchange
Complete draft data before issuance; final issued data before exchange. Public default applies when lookup proves no private entry point.
private entry point found: resolved route
Draft validation includes the early destination check.
Preserve completed actions; append new evidence.
Alternatives for delivery; copy is a separate conditional duty.
Reading key: ellipse = start · parallelogram = ERP data/action · rounded rectangle = task · diamond = decision · document = rule/plan
Cylinder = evidence · dashed trapezoid = external party · dashed hexagon = hold/recovery · solid arrow = flow · dashed arrow = exception
